title: Aggregate balances, better Swaps
summary: Aggregate balances, improved swap quotes, and more going into the final app update of April.
body_markdown:
###### Improved


-


Rainbow now displays your total USD balance for your wallet inside of the Wallet Switcher and Send instead of *just* ETH balances. Even better for L2s!


###### Fixes


-


Improved quote reliability for Swaps


-


Fixed a crash when swapping ProxySwap on Degen Chain


-


Minor copy update when using Send for an L2 network


*Something new is coming soon for Swaps* 🤫
